Because the hardcoded fallback is also Houston (29.7604,-95.3698), I proved geocoding actually drives the center by temporarily switching the job location to 'Dallas City Hall, Dallas, TX': Add Pole center became 32.7769,-96.7978 and Add UG 32.7766,-96.7974 (Dallas City Hall) — then reverted to Houston. Nominatim geocode resolved within ~3-6s. Same verified for underground popup (b25d7718-…, HH-1) — toggled on/off with correct toasts, reverted. (7) REGRESSION: created BLANK-REG-TEST with employee/site id blank — edit dialog shows placeholder 'Select employee' and empty site id, its ASE form loads with both fields empty; seed job ASE form loads and all 4 tabs navigate with ZERO console errors. Cleanup done: ASE-AUTO-TEST, SITEID-TEST (42eaab58-…) and BLANK-REG-TEST all deleted (moved to Deleted Items).

issues: Longitude input is pre-seeded with the literal string '-' (value='-', not a placeholder) while Latitude is empty — inconsistent and looks like a stray character. Pre-existing (UndergroundForm.jsx line 65/111), not part of this batch.
'DISABLE NTE AUTO-ASSIGNMENT' is rendered as a free-text input; a yes/no or toggle control would be more appropriate. Pre-existing, low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: lib/jobAddressCenter.js caches geocode results per jobId for the page lifetime including negative results (null). If a user fixes/changes job.location and returns to Add Pole without a hard reload, the stale/null cache is reused. Consider keying the cache on the location string, or invalidating on job update.

jobAddressCenter.js calls Nominatim with no custom User-Agent/Referer and no rate-limit guard. Nominatim's usage policy requires an identifying UA and max 1 req/s; heavy field use could get the app throttled/blocked. Consider a backend-proxied geocode with caching.

PoleForm.jsx line 612: fallback center [29.7604,-95.3698] is hardcoded (Houston). Fine functionally, but it makes 'geocode worked' indistinguishable from 'geocode failed' for Houston jobs — worth surfacing a small indicator or moving the fallback to a constant/env.

ASEForm.jsx email-extraction useEffect only fills building_contact_email when empty (correct per spec), but SVCL 'Building Contact' name field is left empty with the raw contact string used only as a placeholder — confirm that's intended for export.
JobsList.jsx edit-job Location/Description inputs have no placeholder while the create dialog does — minor inconsistency.
